description: This file defines a Validator struct and associated functions for validating Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs) using CEL (Common Expression Language). It includes methods for compiling validation rules, validating objects, and handling validation expressions, with support for nested schemas and validation rules.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Represents a compiled set of CEL validation rules for a Kubernetes schema, supporting nested schemas and validation expressions.

methods.name: NewValidator
methods.description: Creates a new Validator by compiling all CEL validation rules from the provided schema.

methods.name: validator
methods.description: Recursively creates a Validator for schema validations, including nested items, properties, and allOf validators.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates an object against the compiled CEL validation rules, returning validation errors and remaining cost budget.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Internal method that performs the validation logic, including expression evaluation and nested schema validation.

methods.name: validateExpressions
methods.description: Evaluates CEL validation expressions for a given object, handling cost budgeting and error reporting.

methods.name: validateMap
methods.description: Validates map-type objects according to schema rules, including additionalProperties and property validations.

methods.name: validateArray
methods.description: Validates array-type objects according to schema rules.

methods.name: MapIsCorrelatable
methods.description: Determines if a map type supports correlation for validation purposes.
